findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_validate, email_security, web_extract, web_headers, web_robots, web_sitemap, html_extract, evm_verify_message, x402_check, x402_search, hmac · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_mx, dns_spf, dns_dmarc, email_validate, email_security, evm_contract, evm_selector_lookup, evm_tx, evm_token, evm_balance, evm_units, evm_verify_message, ip_info, json_validate, json_diff, jwt_decode, random · Public sink: dns_reverse, email_validate, email_security, html_extract, ens_resolve, cidr_info, json_validate, hmac · Destructive: evm_address, evm_units, json_format, json_diff, text_transform, cron_next.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_validate, email_security, web_extract, web_headers, web_robots, web_sitemap, html_extract, evm_verify_message, x402_check, x402_search, hmac · Private data: dns_lookup, dns_mx, dns_spf, dns_dmarc, email_validate, email_security, evm_contract, evm_selector_lookup, evm_tx, evm_token, evm_balance, evm_units, evm_verify_message, ip_info, json_validate, json_diff, jwt_decode, random · Public sink: dns_reverse, email_validate, email_security, html_extract, ens_resolve, cidr_info, json_validate, hmac · Destructive: evm_address, evm_units, json_format, json_diff, text_transform, cron_next

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
